newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds close tradeless, soybean meal lower.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds close tradeless, soybean meal lower.

text.p: UK meals and feeds closed tradeless after yet another day of inactivity as far as attracting any business was concerned, traders said.

Currency factors resulted in sellers dropping soybean meal prices by two to 2.50 sterling per tonne, with gains in early Chicago soybean meal futures on top of a firmer close on Monday in the U.S., having possible limited the downward move, they added.
Rapemeal and sunflower selling levels were left unchanged from Monday's finish.
